beginner.title: Get started with NIMC Mobile ID
beginner.outcome: You can: set up NIMC Mobile ID, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Set up your business
beginner.outcome: You can: configure NIMC Mobile ID for your business
beginner.practice: Set up your profile and three services or products

beginner.title: Daily operations
beginner.outcome: You can: run day-to-day work in NIMC Mobile ID

intermediate.title: Customers and data
intermediate.outcome: You can: keep clean customer and transaction records
intermediate.practice: Import or clean up your customer list

intermediate.title: Reports that matter
intermediate.outcome: You can: read the reports that guide decisions
intermediate.practice: Review last month's report and pick one action

intermediate.title: Signature skills in NIMC Mobile ID
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make NIMC Mobile ID distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced NIMC Mobile ID
expert.outcome: You can: use NIMC Mobile ID's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Scale and control
expert.outcome: You can: run NIMC Mobile ID across a team or branches
expert.practice: Set up roles for staff and review the audit log

expert.title: Integrate NIMC Mobile ID into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect NIMC Mobile ID with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect NIMC Mobile ID to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use NIMC Mobile ID well
